sources.snippet: Schema-driven information extraction and classification — entities, labels, records, relations, and span attributes in one local model. GLiNER2 is a schema-conditioned encoder family for Named Entity Recognition, Text Classification, Structured Data Extraction, Relation Extraction, and span attributes.
